body:
So, first of all, this is not a Avicus team, So if you are here Looking for A Avicus Team, then this post is not were you have to be. So, since Kohi doesnt have a Forum, I decided to post it Here. First of all this is not a Factions team, its a ``Big fight team´´ Which basiclly is duels 20v20 or more in Kohi´s practice server.

What do you need?
-A teamspeak account.
-A skype account
-A Michrophone.

In order to join the team, youll have to pass some tests. What you have to do is leave the Owner(AndreCPvP26) And Myself to at least 3.5 hearts or kill us, If not, You will be denied.

The application format is this:
IGN:
Rate your self on 1 to 5 in PvP:
Skype account:
Do you have a teamspeak account?
Timezone:
